The historical cardinal-biography note at 38010–38021 belongs to the preceding biography at 37967–37982 and is excluded. The topical witchcraft note at 38022–38025 belongs to this act despite its inconsistent printed/OCR marker, which is not harmonized; the lexical historical note at 38089–38091 is also retained. Conventional derogation/sanction etc. at the close remains literal. The frozen empty date_raw is preserved despite the printed dating clause.
